objects.trigger trg_users_change_mail: CREATE TRIGGER trg_users_change_mail AFTER UPDATE OF folded_mail ON users WHEN NEW.folded_mail IS NOT NULL AND NEW.folded_mail IS NOT OLD.folded_mail AND NEW.email IS NOT OLD.email BEGIN UPDATE users SET mail_attempt_from =(SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id),0)FROM login_attempt),mail_audit_from =(SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id),0)FROM audit)WHERE id = NEW.id; END
objects.trigger trg_users_change_name: CREATE TRIGGER trg_users_change_name AFTER UPDATE OF folded_name ON users WHEN NEW.folded_name IS NOT NULL AND NEW.folded_name IS NOT OLD.folded_name AND NEW.username IS NOT OLD.username BEGIN UPDATE users SET name_attempt_from =(SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id),0)FROM login_attempt),name_audit_from =(SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id),0)FROM audit)WHERE id = NEW.id; END
objects.trigger trg_users_folded_mail: CREATE TRIGGER trg_users_folded_mail AFTER UPDATE OF email ON users WHEN NEW.folded_mail IS OLD.folded_mail AND NEW.email IS NOT OLD.email BEGIN UPDATE users SET folded_mail = NULL,mail_attempt_from =(SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id),0)FROM login_attempt),mail_audit_from =(SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id),0)FROM audit)WHERE id = NEW.id; END
objects.trigger trg_users_folded_name: CREATE TRIGGER trg_users_folded_name AFTER UPDATE OF username ON users WHEN NEW.folded_name IS OLD.folded_name AND NEW.username IS NOT OLD.username BEGIN UPDATE users SET folded_name = NULL,name_attempt_from =(SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id),0)FROM login_attempt),name_audit_from =(SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id),0)FROM audit)WHERE id = NEW.id; END
objects.trigger trg_users_identifier_insert: CREATE TRIGGER trg_users_identifier_insert BEFORE INSERT ON users WHEN(NEW.folded_name IS NOT NULL AND NEW.folded_name <> '' AND(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE(folded_name = NEW.folded_name OR folded_mail = NEW.folded_name))OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM federated_identity WHERE directory_name_folded = NEW.folded_name)))OR(NEW.folded_mail IS NOT NULL AND NEW.folded_mail <> '' AND(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE(folded_name = NEW.folded_mail OR folded_mail = NEW.folded_mail))OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM federated_identity WHERE directory_name_folded = NEW.folded_mail)))BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'tinysesam: identifier taken'); END
objects.trigger trg_users_identifier_update: CREATE TRIGGER trg_users_identifier_update BEFORE UPDATE OF username,email ON users WHEN(NEW.folded_name IS NOT OLD.folded_name AND NEW.folded_name <> '' AND(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE id IS NOT NEW.id AND(folded_name = NEW.folded_name OR folded_mail = NEW.folded_name))OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM federated_identity WHERE user_id IS NOT NEW.id AND directory_name_folded = NEW.folded_name)))OR(NEW.folded_mail IS NOT OLD.folded_mail AND NEW.folded_mail <> '' AND(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE id IS NOT NEW.id AND(folded_name = NEW.folded_mail OR folded_mail = NEW.folded_mail))OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM federated_identity WHERE user_id IS NOT NEW.id AND directory_name_folded = NEW.folded_mail)))BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'tinysesam: identifier taken'); END
